The party has been invited to a high stakes gambling night by Lord Tlaloc. He is a friend of the party and wants them to attend as his guests. 

NPCs:
- Cerkil the Drake
- Tlaloc the Red Warlock
- Diego the Blessed
- Kijma Kimina
- Elena Syrell

STAKES:
- Cerkil will pledge enough money to hire the [[Windwalker Mercenaries]] (500 Soldiers)
- Diego will offer the party information about a rare and powerful artifact, the painting of Lazarus' feast after defeating Arkonil, [[The Feast of Devil's Rest Painting]]
- Tlaloc reveals the info that a powerful witch has taken over the underground city of Ironpetal, a witch bearing the name Rex. Ivar has been sending some of his soldiers there to receive some powerful black magic from her.
